about: NDA texts sealed by the web console's sealNdaText (src/lib/files/share/nda/nda-crypto.ts) with a fixed nonce. The comment key is HKDF-SHA256 of share_key_hex, as in share_comments_vectors.json. Desktop must seal each text to these exact bytes and open each one, so a text set in either app opens in the other. text_hash is BLAKE3 derive_key("hippius.hcfs.share-nda-text.v1", text); the first case is the hcfs docs' known answer.
